arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show the result

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specify queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: detection_model
arg.description: Path or URL of the text detection model of DB (onnx), empty for DB (ResNet-18, IC15) of opencv_zoo

arg.name: recognition_model
arg.description: Path or URL of the text recognition model of CRNN (onnx), empty for CRNN (English) of opencv_zoo, or none to detect the text only

arg.name: vocabulary
arg.description: Path or URL of the vocabulary of the recognition model, one character per line, or empty for 0-9 and a-z of CRNN (English)

arg.name: backend
arg.description: Backend of cv::dnn: auto, cpu, opencl, opencl_fp16, cuda or cuda_fp16. auto uses CUDA when OpenCV is built with CUDA and a CUDA device is found, and the CPU otherwise.

arg.name: input_width
arg.description: Width of the input of the detection model, a multiple of 32

arg.name: input_height
arg.description: Height of the input of the detection model, a multiple of 32

arg.name: binary_threshold
arg.description: Threshold of the text probability of the pixels

arg.name: polygon_threshold
arg.description: Threshold of the score of the text regions

arg.name: unclip_ratio
arg.description: Ratio to expand the detected text regions

arg.name: max_candidates
arg.description: Maximum number of the text regions
